decisions.reason: The black-finish multi-model range is close to the core, matches the design-led direction the firm has announced, and has already been tooled and published, so management would put its modest website visibility down to market build-up and keep it.

The pump-assisted line represents substantial development investment and is central to the barrier-free direction, and the 2024 pump-drain shower channel extends this course, so management would persist and treat weak results as temporary ramp-up.
The tileable floor drain has its own page, which signals public commitment, it sits next to the core offer, and it costs little to keep, so there is no reason to withdraw it.
The stainless steel design grate embodies the firm's combination of design and engineering and is visibly presented, so management remains committed to it.

Launched in 2024 with a page of its own and building on the pump-assisted line, the pump-drain shower channel is a fresh, publicly announced bet on barrier-free bathrooms that management would not abandon after one year.
